description: If a structure satisfies the row problem of a quantifier-free ground formula, that actual formula is true exactly when its skeleton evaluates to true under the same specified row.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton_truth_of_row.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)] (A : L.Sentence)
  (hA : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF A)
  (b : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Atom L → Bool) (M : Type w) [L.Structure M]
  (hM :
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.Satisfies
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.rowProblem
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.atoms
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A))
        b)
      M) :
  M ⊨ A ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval b (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.skeleton A) =
      true
